simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֲזָא (H228) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֲזָא (ʼăzâʼ) means to kindle ; (by implication) to heat First listed occurrence: Dan 3 19.

definitions.full: H228. aza [ אֲזָא ] verb make hot, heat ( ᵑ7 id . [rare]; compare Arabic kindle, burn ); — Pe`al Infinitive לְמֵזֵא (§ 11, 3 b)) Dan 3:19 ( ל accusative), suffix לְמֵזְיֵהּ 3:19 ; Passive participle אֵוֵה (K § 15 e ) 3:22 .
